question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a red present, Bob has a orange present, Claire has a brown present, Dave has a blue present, Eve has a purple present, Fred has a yellow present, and Gertrude has a white present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Eve and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Eve swap their gifts. Finally, Gertrude and Fred swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Claire has the
Options:
(A) red present
(B) orange present
(C) brown present
(D) blue present
(E) purple present
(F) yellow present
(G) white present
solution:
Present colors are listed in holder order: (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (red, orange, brown, blue, purple, yellow, white)
1. Eve and Gertrude swap: (red, orange, brown, blue, white, yellow, purple)
2. Claire and Bob swap: (red, brown, orange, blue, white, yellow, purple)
3. Fred and Alice swap: (yellow, brown, orange, blue, white, red, purple)
4. Dave and Eve swap: (yellow, brown, orange, white, blue, red, purple)
5. Eve and Fred swap: (yellow, brown, orange, white, red, blue, purple)
6. Bob and Eve swap: (yellow, red, orange, white, brown, blue, purple)
7. Gertrude and Fred swap: (yellow, red, orange, white, brown, purple, blue)
Claire has the orange present, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
